title: Vascular system anatomy
description: Two trees from one pump: arteries deliver under pressure, veins return against gravity — with valves, shunts and plexuses throughout.

questions.question: What is the difference between arteries and veins?
questions.answer: Arteries carry blood away from the heart and veins return it. The distinction is direction of flow, not oxygen level: pulmonary arteries carry less-oxygenated blood.

questions.question: What is the aorta's role in circulation?
questions.answer: The aorta receives blood from the left ventricle and supplies the systemic arterial tree through branches serving the head, trunk and limbs.

questions.question: What is the aortic arch?
questions.answer: Curve giving brachiocephalic, left carotid, left subclavian. Function: Distributes to head and arms.

questions.question: Where is the subclavian artery located?
questions.answer: Under clavicle to axillary artery. Function: Arm supply; gives vertebral to brain.

questions.question: What is the function of the descending aorta?
questions.answer: Function: Segmental branches to wall and viscera. Thoracic then abdominal aorta.
